fixturePolicy.geometrySyntheticFixture: reuse structure of LGTGMIV Stage-0 hand-derived synthetic convergent graph; no Bao scientific inference
fixturePolicy.engineTechnicalRoots: generate deterministic random legal-move trajectories only from technical seed namespace and select fixed technical roots away from the standard initial root

technicalRootTargets.target: first nonterminal Namua state at or after ply 24 with >=2 legal moves
first nonterminal Mtaji state at or after ply 44 with >=2 legal moves

fixturePolicy.technicalRootReplacement: none within v1; failure to materialize a target is technical-invalid

mandatoryChecks: T2 RAW state identity and 8-field move identity production/independent exact
T3 geometry synthetic hand-derived assertions and production/independent exact equality
T4 real technical-root LGTGMIV depth-5 reconstruction production/independent exact equality
T5 G1..G5 geometry derivation exact and order invariant
T6 all six frozen search conditions deterministic and estimable on required technical roots
T7 production/independent candidate scores, TopSet, canonical best, exact ranking preorder, best-second gap and PV exact agreement
T8 E1..E5 search-instability endpoint exact agreement for SC1..SC3
T9 exact rational comparison, phase-threshold midpoint, risk-difference and candidate-selection synthetic controls
T10 exact stratified hypergeometric convolution formal-test arithmetic against hand-enumerated synthetic tables
T11 static implementation independence: independent G3-07 search/aggregation must not import production G3-07 search/aggregation
T13 fail-closed negative controls for nonfinite score, nonestimable budget, malformed identity and relay-limit sentinel handling
T15 fresh scientific seeds not accessed and protected depth-10 holdout sealed
safeIntegerScoreGate: every persisted scientific search score/gap on technical roots must be Number.isSafeInteger; otherwise Stage 0 technical-invalid
productionIndependentGate: canonical scientific objects and SHA-256 digests must match exactly for all mandatory technical units

stageDispositionRules.pass: all T1..T15 pass and resource ceilings pass
stageDispositionRules.nonEstimable: technical computation is valid but a frozen resource ceiling alone prevents completion

noRerunRule: same v1 trigger may not be rerun as a completed Stage-0 execution; a new technical version requires a prospective fresh-free program record and may not change the scientific Study contract
